mapper.select:
SELECT CP.* FROM shopion.tPrfCustConcrnProd CP INNER JOIN shopion.tPrdProd P ON CP.ProdCode = P.ProdCode INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CP.CustId = CI.CustId
AND CI.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND CI.CustName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCustName},'%') AND CI.LoginId LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pLoginId},'%') AND CI.CustId = #{pCustId}
AND P.SaleYn = 1
ORDER BY ${sidx} ${sord} ORDER BY CP.RegistDate DESC
